title: Add Split Button
content: Create split button. Container: inline-flex rounded-lg shadow. Primary button: px-4 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-l-lg hover:bg-blue-600, main action text. Dropdown trigger: px-2 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-r-lg border-l border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-600, chevron icon. Dropdown menu: absolute top-full right-0 mt-1 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border, menu items py-2 px-4 hover:bg-gray-100.

variants.simple: Create button with dropdown for secondary actions.
variants.detailed: Create split button. Container: inline-flex rounded-lg shadow. Primary button: px-4 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-l-lg hover:bg-blue-600, main action text. Dropdown trigger: px-2 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-r-lg border-l border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-600, chevron icon. Dropdown menu: absolute top-full right-0 mt-1 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border, menu items py-2 px-4 hover:bg-gray-100.
variants.advanced: Create versatile split button component. Layout: main button + dropdown toggle sharing same height/style. Primary action: larger area, text and optional icon, onClick handler. Dropdown toggle: smaller area, chevron/caret icon, opens menu on click. Menu positioning: below by default, flip to top if near viewport bottom (use Floating UI). Menu items: text, icon optional, keyboard shortcut hint, disabled state, separator/divider option. Selection: clicking menu item can either fire action and close, or change the primary button action (remember last used). Menu sections: group items with headers. Variants: primary, secondary, outline, ghost - applied to both parts. Sizes: sm, md, lg. Disabled: both parts disabled, or just dropdown disabled. Loading: spinner in primary button during async action. Keyboard: Tab focuses button, Enter activates, Escape closes menu, arrow keys navigate menu. Controlled: isOpen and onOpenChange props. Close behavior: close on item click, close on outside click, close on Escape. Mobile: consider full button opening menu instead of split. Accessibility: aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, menu has role="menu", items role="menuitem".
